release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.7.7 — Background Zero-Touch OTA Auto-Update Engine:
• Continuous Background Auto-Update Monitor: FocusForegroundService checks for new releases every 15 minutes in the background without needing to open Settings or click check.
• One-Tap Quick Update Action: High-priority heads-up notification with a direct [UPDATE NOW] button that downloads and launches the installer seamlessly.
• Smart Multi-Tier Network Discovery: Auto-probes local Wi-Fi dev server (192.168.29.239 / gateway) with ultra-fast transfer speeds before falling back to cloud Vercel/Supabase.
• Sideload Installer Safety: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission and unknown sources handler integrated.
